description: Read brand templates, validate documents, derive recipes or inspect staged drafts. Use it when preparing a brand without saving; use brand_create to stage or create it. Returns complete template slots, validation findings, a recipe with provenance and gaps, or draft evidence. derive takes exactly one of tokens, css or absolute cssPath. Template replies use compact JSON so all themes fit inline. Full schema: oods://schemas/brand_read.input.json.

brand_id.description: The id the brand will have. Checked when given: capitals then digits (ACME, A1) or a letter then lower-case letters and digits (Acme, acme2), at most 32 characters, and no existing brand's id in any case. Actions: validate.

css.description: A shadcn theme CSS entry, in place of tokens. Actions: derive. See full schema for details.

cssPath.description: Absolute path to the shadcn theme CSS entry, in place of tokens or css. Read only. Actions: derive.

documents.description: The filled template: one plain design-token document per theme, brand-relative (surface.canvas, not color.brand.<id>.surface.canvas), each slot {"$type": "color", "$value": "<CSS colour>"}. Actions: validate.

from.description: Where the starting values come from: an existing brand (default A), optionally with one of the shipped presets over it; or a recipe, which gives the complete brand, graded. Actions: template.

brand.description: An existing brand whose values the template starts from. Default: A.

preset.description: A shipped preset id whose values go over the brand's; every template response lists the… See full schema for details.

recipe.description: A brand recipe: the neutral (a hue and a tint of 0 to 0.03), the accent hue, whether the… See full schema for details.

hints.description: Exact dot-separated token paths, or CSS custom property names, that override inference. Invalid hints produce gaps, never silent fallback. Actions: derive.

recipe.description: A brand recipe in place of documents: the brand it gives is checked, and for create written, like filled documents. Actions: validate.

tokens.description: A DTCG document with your own token names. Group $type is inherited; {group.token} aliases resolve inside the document. Actions: derive.

name: brand_read
title: Read Brand Data
